title: Battlepack section 7 — Gambits (targets)

container.notes: Section 7 of battle_pack.bin (71-section battlepack: u32 count, count+1 u32 offsets incl. an unpadded end offset, sections 16-byte aligned with zero fill). The section itself is an st2e table: 32-byte header (magic, u32 entryCount @4, u16 entrySize @8, u32 entryListOffset @12 = 32, u32 textSectionOffset @20 = 0) followed by packed entries and zero padding to 16 bytes.

fields.name: magic
fields.notes: ASCII 'st2e' (73 74 32 65); reject the section if different.

fields.name: entryCount
fields.notes: Number of gambit targets (256 in the vanilla game, TK L809).

fields.name: entrySize
fields.notes: Bytes per entry; 32 (0x20) for this section.

fields.name: unknown0A
fields.notes: Not interpreted; keep.

fields.name: entryListOffset
fields.notes: Offset of entry 0 from the section start: 32 when entryCount > 0, else 0.

fields.name: offset10
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output).

fields.name: textSectionOffset
fields.notes: Inline text offset; 0 on disk for this section (filled at run time). No strings are stored here.

fields.name: offset18
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output for this section).

fields.name: offset1C
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output).

records.name: gambit
records.where: st2e entries of section 7: header.entryListOffset + i*32

fields.name: unknown00
fields.notes: Not interpreted (Workshop skips and writes zeros).

fields.name: icon
fields.notes: Menu icon; marked "ineffectual" by the Workshop (no visible effect).

fields.name: description
fields.notes: Help text id (gambit-target help block, 16000+).

fields.name: gilCost
fields.notes: Shop price of the gambit.

fields.name: case1TargetCondition
fields.notes: Target condition of case 1 (battle-logic condition id).

fields.name: case2TargetCondition
fields.notes: Target condition of case 2.

fields.name: case3TargetCondition
fields.notes: Target condition of case 3.

fields.name: flags
fields.notes: Gambit behaviour flags. The Workshop keeps the raw u16; bit names come from the Lua Loader docs.

fields.name: case1TargetType
fields.notes: Who case 1 scans (foe, ally, self …).

fields.name: case2TargetType
fields.notes: Target type of case 2.

fields.name: case3TargetType
fields.notes: Target type of case 3.

fields.name: unknown13
fields.notes: Not interpreted.

fields.name: name
fields.notes: Name text id (gambit block, 12288+).

fields.name: gambitPage
fields.notes: Gambit-menu page the entry is listed on.

fields.name: gambitPageOrder
fields.notes: Position on that page.

fields.name: case1Parameter
fields.notes: Parameter of case 1 (meaning depends on the condition: HP %, status, element …).

fields.name: case2Parameter
fields.notes: Parameter of case 2.

fields.name: case3Parameter
fields.notes: Parameter of case 3.

fields.name: unused1E
fields.notes: Padding; the Workshop writes two zero bytes explicitly.

roundTrip: Edit fields in place; the record size is fixed and nothing in this section points at entries, so value edits never move data.

Copy every byte that no field interprets (unknown*/unused*/padding, unnamed bits) from the original; the Workshop writer zero-fills them (it seeks over them), so do not use its output as the byte-identical reference.
Keep the st2e header bytes verbatim except entryCount (and entryListOffset when the count goes to/from 0).
Keep the trailing zero padding that rounds the section to a multiple of 16 bytes.
If the section length changes (added/removed entries), rewrite the battlepack offset table: every later section offset and the end offset shift by the padded size delta.
Do not reorder rows: section 8 and gambit content ids (0x6000|row) refer to them by index.
gaps: Flag bits 0, 1 and 6 are unnamed in every source.
Byte 0x13 and bytes 0x00-0x02 are never interpreted; byte 0x03 (icon) is labelled ineffectual by the Workshop.
Per-condition meaning of case*Parameter is not tabulated by any source we have.
Whether the engine tolerates more than 256 rows is unknown.
